kind.label: What's going on
kind.title: What kind of project?
kind.hint: Pick the closest match. We'll figure out the details together.

urgent.label: Something just happened
urgent.hint: Water, fire, smoke, mold — happening now or in the last 24 hours.

notUrgent.label: Damage I want fixed
notUrgent.hint: Past damage, insurance claim already open or pending.

remodel.label: Planning a remodel
remodel.hint: Kitchen, bathroom, or combined. Not urgent.

notSure.label: Not sure yet
notSure.hint: I want to talk to a person before deciding what category this is.

where.label: Where
where.title: Where's the property?
where.hint: Zip is all we need. Neighborhood helps us route faster.

neighborhood.label: Neighborhood (optional)
neighborhood.placeholder: e.g. Hazel Dell, Camas, Salmon Creek…

when.label: When
when.title: When would you like to start?
when.hint: Pick the closest. We'll talk about real dates on the call.

asap.label: As soon as possible
asap.hint: I'd like work to start this week if possible.

days30.label: Within 30 days
days30.hint: No emergency, but I want momentum.

days90.label: Within 90 days
days90.hint: Planning a project for this season.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: How can we reach you?
contact.hint: We'll call within the hour during business hours. Phone is the fastest way.

done.title: Thanks, {firstName}.
done.body: Your details are with us. If your project is urgent, call now — we answer in person.
